Title: Cyrena.Coding.Core - DevelopPlan Model
Summary: Root model representing the in-memory index of a project's files and folders. Serializable to JSON.
Content:
## DevelopPlan

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.Coding.Models`
**Assembly:** `Cyrena.Coding.Core`

### Purpose
Represents the in-memory index of a project's file and folder structure. Created from a root directory, it indexes files and provides operations for file CRUD.

### Class Definition

```csharp
public class DevelopPlan : IJsonSerializable
{
    public DevelopPlan(string rootDirectory);
    
    [JsonIgnore]
    public string RootDirectory { get; set; }
    
    [JsonIgnore]
    public string DataDirectory { get; set; }  // RootDirectory + "/.cyrena"
    
    public List<DevelopFile> Files { get; set; }
    public List<DevelopFolder> Folders { get; set; }

    public static bool TryLoadFromDirectory(string dir, out DevelopPlan plan);
    public static void Save(DevelopPlan plan);
    public string ToJson();
}
```

### Key Behaviors

- **Persistence**: Saved to `{DataDirectory}/plan` as JSON via `Newtonsoft.Json`
- **Loading**: `TryLoadFromDirectory` attempts to load from `.cyrena/plan`, falls back to new empty plan
- **File IDs**: Files are indexed with prefixed IDs (e.g., `contracts_`, `models_`, `services_`)
- **ReadOnly**: Files can be marked read-only to prevent AI modification

### Extension Methods (DevelopFileExtensions)

| Method | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `CreateFile(plan, fileId, fileName, content)` | Create file in root |
| `CreateFile(plan, folder, fileId, fileName, content)` | Create file in folder |
| `TryReadFileContent(plan, file, out content)` | Read full content |
| `TryReadFileLines(plan, file, out lines)` | Read as line dictionary |
| `TryWriteFileContent(plan, file, content, out fileContent)` | Overwrite content |
| `TryWriteFileLine(plan, file, index, line, out lines)` | Replace single line |
| `TryInsertLine(plan, file, index, line, out lines)` | Insert after index |
| `TryReplaceLines(plan, file, startIndex, count, replacement, out lines)` | Replace block |
| `RemoveFile(plan, file)` | Delete file from disk and plan |
| `TryFindFile(plan, fileId, out file, recursive)` | Find by ID |
| `TryFindFileByName(plan, name, out file, recursive)` | Find by name |
| `IndexFiles(plan, extension, id_prefix, readOnly)` | Auto-index root files |
| `IndexFiles(plan, folder, extension, id_prefix, readOnly)` | Auto-index folder files |

### Extension Methods (DevelopFolderExtensions)

| Method | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `CreateFolder(plan, id, name)` | Create folder in root |
| `CreateFolder(plan, parent, id, name)` | Create nested folder |
| `RemoveFolder(plan, folder, recursive)` | Delete folder |
| `TryFindFolder(plan, folderId, out folder, recursive)` | Find by ID |
| `GetFolderOfFile(plan, file)` | Find containing folder |
| `GetOrCreateFolder(plan, id, name)` | Get or create |
| `GetOrCreateFolder(plan, parent, id, name)` | Get or create nested |
